title: Storm Sorceress at Sea
description: A powerful sorceress with long white hair stands at the center of a massive swirling vortex of water and wind above a stormy ocean. She holds a glowing blue staff in one hand and a large red, white, and blue umbrella in the other, as two blue sea serpents and sailing ships battle the turbulent waves and lightning below.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a powerful female sorceress with long flowing white hair wearing a blue and silver gown, standing at the eye of a massive swirling waterspout in the middle of a stormy ocean. She holds a glowing magical staff emitting blue energy in one hand and a large red white and blue umbrella in the other. Two large blue sea serpents emerge from the turbulent waves, sailing ships with red flags are tossed in the chaotic sea, lightning strikes across the dark cloudy sky filled with rain and debris.
